page.overview:
Who is Tadashi Hasegawa?

Tadashi is the most elderly member of the politician board by far; unlike the other members, he’s entirely bald and confined to a wheelchair.

Tadashi appears to be the most malevolent and influential member of the Japanese board of politicians - even moreso than the prime minister himself - as it was his confirmation that lead to the Aging Devil contract going through. He also holds no qualms with threatening other politicians and their families. His cold disposition crumbles when under threat however, as he pleads with the Aging Devil that he'll do so much good if only he could live longer.

At some point in time, Tadashi Hasegawa was the Minister of Finance of Japan.

Tadashi Hasegawa is one of the Japanese Government Officials who had a meeting in order to discuss the potential of erasing the Aging Devil from existence and its affects on the people of Japan. He was used as a chair by the Aging Devil, while talking about how he's deeply moved and that he must live longer for mankind, so he can "lead the world in the right direction". He is dragged to the Aging's World by the Aging Devil's Victim, where they leave him to stay.
